About.title: About Us
About.story1: We are a perfume house built for Myanmar — bringing authentic fragrances from the world's beloved brands to your doorstep, verified and cared for at every step.
About.story2: Every bottle in our collection is sourced through trusted channels, checked by our team, and packed with care. From first spray to last note, we want your experience to feel effortless.
About.value1: Authenticity first — every product is verified before it reaches you.
About.value2: Fair prices in MMK with no surprises at checkout.
About.value3: Real people on support, ready to help before and after your order.

Contact.title: Contact Us
Contact.intro: Questions about an order, a fragrance, or delivery? We usually reply within one business day.
